definitions.explanation: Reporting or describing events as they happen in real time. Used for sports commentary, live streaming, and real-time reporting of events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{実況|じっきょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To provide live commentary on a game.

examples.japanese: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実況|じっきょう}⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I often watch game livestream videos.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実況|じっきょう}⟦プレイヤー→プレイヤー：15082_pureiyaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配信|はいしん}して→配信する：23206_haishinsuru⟧、{何万人|なんまんにん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{視聴者|しちょうしゃ}→視聴者：02570_shichousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: A popular livestreamer broadcast a new game and attracted tens of thousands of viewers.

notes:
USAGE:
Traditionally associated with sports broadcasting ({実況|じっきょう}⟦{中継|ちゅうけい}→中継：11306_chuukei⟧), where an announcer provides play-by-play commentary. In modern usage, {実況|じっきょう} has become strongly associated with online gaming and video streaming. {実況|じっきょう}⟦プレイ→プレイ：12840_purei⟧ (let's play, gameplay commentary) and ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧{実況|じっきょう} (game streaming) are extremely popular online.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実況|じっきょう}⟦{中継|ちゅうけい}→中継：11306_chuukei⟧: live broadcast, live relay
- ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧{実況|じっきょう}: game streaming, gameplay commentary
- {実況|じっきょう}⟦プレイ→プレイ：12840_purei⟧: let's play, commentary playthrough
- {実況|じっきょう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: commentator, livestreamer
- {実況|じっきょう}⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧: livestream video
